speaker: David Vance
text: Good morning everyone, welcome to the phase two diligence session for Project Falcon.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Thanks David. Acme Capital is pleased with initial diligence, but today we need clarity on financials and customer concentration.

speaker: Sarah Chen
text: Happy to walk through the numbers. For fiscal year 2023, Northwind Analytics generated eighteen million in total revenue.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: And on the profitability side, Sarah? We have been analyzing the adjusted operating metrics.

speaker: Sarah Chen
text: Our EBITDA was 4.2 million for the last fiscal year, representing an operating margin of approximately twenty-three percent.

speaker: David Vance
text: That is solid expansion from FY22. Our gross margin also stabilized at seventy-eight percent.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Understood. Now regarding corporate expenses, we noticed a software infrastructure commitment pending approval.

speaker: Sarah Chen
text: Yes, I approve the fifteen thousand dollars vendor expenditure for CloudScale Systems data migration.

speaker: David Vance
text: That migration is scheduled for completion within the next thirty days.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Let us discuss the transaction perimeter. Acme is structuring this as an asset purchase agreement with a ten percent holdback.

speaker: David Vance
text: Northwind board reviewed the term sheet. The indicative valuation of forty-five million enterprise value is acceptable.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: We will require a forty-five day exclusivity window starting immediately upon signature.

speaker: David Vance
text: The board agreed to the exclusivity term during yesterday's special meeting.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Now regarding customer accounts, we notice significant revenue tied to two large enterprise clients.

speaker: David Vance
text: Yes, customer concentration is our primary diligence risk: our top two enterprise accounts account for forty-five percent of ARR.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Are both contracts up for renewal within the next twelve months?

speaker: Sarah Chen
text: The primary account is on a multi-year term through 2026. The second renews in November.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Priya, could your team prepare the detailed customer cohort analysis and churn data?

speaker: Priya Sharma
text: Priya sends customer concentration data by Friday. I will have the breakdown ready by end of day Friday.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Perfect. What about key personnel retention post-closing?

speaker: David Vance
text: All senior engineers and department heads will enter into non-compete and retention agreements.

speaker: Sarah Chen
text: Special advisor Zephyrine Quillfeather confirmed the audit schedule and compliance checklist.

speaker: David Vance
text: Zephyrine reviewed the environmental and security diligence questionnaires as well.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Any outstanding litigation or regulatory inquiries we should be aware of?

speaker: David Vance
text: Zero pending litigation. We completed our SOC 2 Type II audit last quarter without exceptions.

speaker: Sarah Chen
text: Total cash on balance sheet currently stands at three million two hundred thousand dollars.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: And long-term debt obligations?

speaker: Sarah Chen
text: We have a credit line of one million with Zenith Bank, currently drawn at four hundred thousand.

speaker: David Vance
text: Acme will not assume that credit line; it will be paid off at closing from transaction proceeds.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Agreed. Let us ensure the definitive purchase agreement reflects that payoff.

speaker: Priya Sharma
text: On product roadmap, our machine learning pipeline is launching in late Q3.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Does that require additional capital expenditures in the current year?

speaker: Sarah Chen
text: No, budgeted CapEx of two hundred fifty thousand covers all hardware and hosting costs.

speaker: David Vance
text: We have maintained a disciplined cash burn rate of under fifty thousand per month.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Excellent. Who is handling intellectual property assignment confirmations?

speaker: David Vance
text: Marcus, our outside counsel will provide IP assignment certificates for all eighty-five employees.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: Please have those uploaded to the data room by Monday afternoon.

speaker: Sarah Chen
text: I will coordinate with legal counsel to ensure all IP schedules are posted by Monday.

speaker: David Vance
text: To recap next steps: Priya sends cohort data by Friday, legal uploads IP certificates by Monday.

speaker: Marcus Brody
text: And Acme team will circulate the revised asset purchase agreement by next Wednesday.

speaker: Sarah Chen
text: Thank you everyone for the constructive session today.

speaker: David Vance
text: Thank you all, meeting adjourned.
